title: a record's tier by its collection
line: the registry sync writes each collection's tier from the registry's ServedAs column: FamilySearch's NUMIDENT collection takes the tier of the Social Security applications row that names it, a census collection no row names takes none and its record reads its holder's tier

steps.say: his Social Security record arrives from FamilySearch
the registry synced: the collections' tiers from data/data-sources.csv

expect.why: the registry's Social Security applications row names FamilySearch's NUMIDENT collection in its ServedAs column, so the collection carries that row's tier and the record reads it
no registry row names the census collection: it carries no tier of its own and the page reads its holder's, FamilySearch's
